description.value: Sushi Mori is a Japanese fusion restaurant in South Surrey near White Rock, specializing in sushi, sashimi, and special rolls using fresh ingredients including tuna, salmon, and sockeye salmon. Open since 2015, it is one of three Lower Mainland locations and draws on over 100 staff across the group. The restaurant features a vintage interior with natural stone and wood materials alongside an exclusive house special sauce made from fruits and vegetables.
